findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_providers, get_provider, search_gift_ideas, parse_guest_list, get_provider_inquiries · Public sink: update_wedding · Destructive: get_day_of_timeline, set_run_sheet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_providers, get_provider, search_gift_ideas, parse_guest_list, get_provider_inquiries · Public sink: update_wedding · Destructive: get_day_of_timeline, set_run_sheet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
